title: Instrument I-05: Field Verifier and Chronolocator
hypothesis: Surfacing observe.ts (sceneGeometry, verifyObservation, chronolocate, geolocate) as interactive browser Instrument I-05 on ephemengine.com lets users and developers verify shadow/sky claims, chronolocate scenes, and run celestial fixes locally in-browser with copyable TypeScript calls.
null_baseline: Static documentation examples and CLI-only MCP calls without interactive visual shadow/horizon/globe feedback.
success_bar: All 3 modes (Verify, Chronolocate, Geolocate) render deterministically in-browser on embeddedData at <50 ms per interaction, match Workbench grammar (I-01..I-04), pass widget unit tests, Next web build/smoke, Astro site build/smoke, and full npm run preflight.
kill_criterion: Bundle size exceeds Workbench instrument budget or browser embedded-tier accuracy diverges from observe-golden.json tolerances.
